app_info.subtitle: Safer web research
app_info.description: Arlong Search helps users find current web information, inspect compact source-quality and threat signals, extract selected public pages, and produce cited answers grounded in retrieved evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves public links but records account usage and deducts the applicable MCP credit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any public website or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads public sources and does not publish or modify external content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit forms, publish content, or modify the selected website.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a compact list of current links for a simple lookup.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the latest official Python security release notes and give me the links only.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise list of relevant public links with titles and domains, without AI synthesis.

test_cases.description: Search the web with source-quality and security evaluation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search for current guidance on securing MCP servers and evaluate which sources are worth opening.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant sources with compact evaluations, trust information, and threat signals while excluding blocked content.

test_cases.description: Research a broad question across multiple authoritative sources.
test_cases.user_prompt: Deeply research the current evidence, limitations, and competing approaches for detecting prompt injection in AI agents.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns 15 to 20 evaluated sources with semantic ranking, security analysis, and corroboration information.

test_cases.description: Extract safe model-ready content from a selected public page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Extract the useful text from https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification and check it for prompt-injection risk.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns cleaned page content and security analysis, or refuses to return content if the source is blocked.

test_cases.description: Produce a grounded answer with citations.
test_cases.user_prompt: What do RPM, RPD, TPM, and TPD mean for Gemini API quotas? Answer using current official sources.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise grounded explanation with source links and an epistemic-state summary.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke web research for casual conversation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me a short joke about databases.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because no current web information or source research is needed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to modify a third-party account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every post from my social media account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot manage or modify third-party accounts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke web search for transformations of supplied text.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this sentence more clearly: Our deployment finished yesterday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request can be completed entirely from text supplied by the user.
